verdict.rationale: CodeAgent writes its actions as Python code that invokes tools and performs computations, so an agent can in principle loop over many items in one action. A manager agent can also delegate work to managed agents. However, nothing in the evidence documents bulk or batch operations as a feature; the capability is only implied by the code-as-action design. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of batch or bulk processing across many items, examples of iterating tool calls over collections, parallel or batched execution support, and hands-on corroboration.
